result:
Run complete. Tree is clean (the three untracked JSONs are the overnight runner's own stage-output files, not mine).

## UI Consistency Audit — Run 119

**2 defects found, 2 fixed, 0 regressions, build PASS (7.92s), 0 DB writes.**

### Defect 1 — recovered work (`3d9c358`)
`git status` as a first action found a **complete but uncommitted** fix in the tree: the prior stage capped mid-work. `LeadDetail.jsx:1538`'s "Add Expense" deep-links to `/expenses?leadId=…`, but `ExpensesView` never read the param — users landed on a plain list and had to re-pick the job by hand. I verified it both directions (with param → modal prefilled "14910 Hartsmith Dr."; without → no modal), then committed it. That rule has now rescued a capped stage's work on five separate nights.

### Defect 2 — new dimension, found on first probe (`68c968a`)
I took **empty-state copy correctness**. Coverage was already fine; the copy was not. Contracts, Invoices and Expenses render their empty message on a bare `length === 0`, but all three filter *server-side* and refetch — so filtering to zero matches showed empty-**database** copy:

| Route | Filter | Rendered | Actually in DB |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/contracts` | Signed | "No contracts yet — create your first one" | **4** |
| `/invoices` | Overdue | "No invoices yet" + "Create your first invoice…" | **14** |
| `/expenses` | Permit | "No expenses yet — add your first one" | **2** |

The app told the user their data was gone while the filter control still visibly read the chosen status. Fixed by making each message conditional on its own filter state, using the idiom the codebase already has (`MaterialsView`, `TasksView`) rather than inventing one. `WorkOrdersView` looked identical but I deliberately left it alone — its kanban has no filter, so `length === 0` genuinely means none.

### Audits 1–7 — 18th consecutive convergence (1 tool call)
56px header + `<h1>` on 19/19, 0 foreign icons, 0 native `<select>`/date inputs, 0 overlays at rest, 0 horizontal overflow, uniform primary buttons. Two apparent deltas I chased down and **cleared rather than filed**: `.is-active`=2 on `/reports`/`/tasks` is the sidebar plus a legitimate in-page segmented control, and the 18-vs-22 sidebar count is the active route's group auto-expanding.

I also opened and **closed two dimensions clean**: disabled-state consistency (a global rule covers all native controls; no custom component is handed a `disabled` prop) and silent text clipping (one signature app-wide, and it isn't clipped — `overflow:visible`, text ends 13px inside the cell padding).

Artifact written to both `C:/tmp/ui-audit-results.txt` and `/tmp/ui-audit-results.txt`; resume log, `MEMORY.md` and the standing gotchas updated with the new traps and non-bugs.

One thing worth your call: the remaining unmeasured UI dimensions are `prefers-reduced-motion` and a print stylesheet. Both are **enhancements rather than QA**, so I didn't spend the night on either — the next run's suggested in-charter target is copy correctness of other conditional states (loading, error, partial-result), which is the same shape that produced tonight's defect.
